settings.title: Woven for You
settings.content:
Thank you for choosing a piece from House of Kala Katha.

What you have ordered passed through many hands before it reached ours: someone who grew or gathered the fibre, someone who spun or dyed it, and a weaver who spent days, sometimes weeks, turning it into cloth. We started this house because we wanted those hands to be seen, and because we believe India’s textiles belong in everyday wardrobes, not only in wedding trunks.

Wear it often. Handloom softens and deepens with use, and it is happiest when it is lived in.
